builds.name: Reference: Multi-target carry
builds.goal: Reference for Jinx: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged sustained-damage carry who swaps close attack speed for rocket range and splash, then accelerates after a takedown. Traps and Zap provide setup rather than reliable instant escape. Record minigun stacks versus rocket range and Get Excited state. Runaan and rocket splash must be tested together; takedown acceleration is earned, not permanently active. Runaan asks whether real multi-target attacks improve teamfight output.
builds.summary: Runaan asks whether real multi-target attacks improve teamfight output.
testPlan: Kit question for Jinx: Record minigun stacks versus rocket range and Get Excited state. Runaan and rocket splash must be tested together; takedown acceleration is earned, not permanently active.

Start with the early core (Yun Tal, then Runaan) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Runaan asks whether real multi-target attacks improve teamfight output. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Jinx modifies her basic attacks by swapping between Pow-Pow, her minigun and Fishbones, her rocket launcher. Attacks with Pow-Pow grant Attack Speed, while attacks with Fishbones deal area of effect damage, gain increased range, but drain Mana and attack slower.
